# gitsubmodule — sourced from .gitmodules. Versionless here: the pinned
# commit lives in .git/index gitlink entries, and a .git directory cannot be
# committed as a fixture; SHA resolution is proven by the extractor's unit
# tests, which encode a real index with go-git at test time.
